answer: Build a grader co-occurrence matrix and flag collusion by statistical correlation, not single errors. Panels are drawn randomly by the epoch beacon, so honest graders meet on shared answers only now and then across the whole orchard of reviewers; their agreement tracks chance. A ring that repeatedly co-grades its own fakes to fake quorum shows a sharp pulse of pairwise agreement far above that baseline — a signal standing out of the river of normal noise. Rank every grader pair by excess co-voting beyond the random draw; the tail of that distribution is the ring.
